quote: We apply this method to understand the self‑attention mechanism of a larger model (BERT) for the more complex NLP task of subject‑verb agreement, not to generate text.
We measure the difficulty of a task with the minimum description length (MDL) and report validation accuracy, but no automatic generation metrics such as BLEU are used.
Our analysis computes gradients and entropy; no language model is used after generation to judge outputs.
The study relies on gradient analysis and does not involve human raters or crowdsourced evaluations.
